notes: Three routes by «ح». The text writes the names after الأعمش only in the third route, so no tail is shared: the first two groups stop where the text stops (kept as written, no tail invented).
«أبي» (father of ابن نمير) is a bare relation; عبد الله بن نمير in route 1 is the same man, not merged.
«غير أن في حديث سفيان» is a wording variant of the saying: left out.
